BlitzyAnnounceEnable.description: @var bool Whether the announcement bar is rendered above the navigation card. The shipped default is false; the verification instance sets it from the BLITZY_ANNOUNCE_ENABLE environment variable. Read by MediaWiki\Skins\Blitzy\BlitzyViewModel, which omits includes/templates/AnnouncementBar.mustache entirely when this is false, so a disabled bar is absent from the DOM rather than hidden.

BlitzyAnnounceText.description: @var string Body text of the announcement bar, anchored to the BLITZY_ANNOUNCE_TEXT environment variable. Read by BlitzyViewModel, which strips ASCII control characters and trims the value; HTML escaping happens once, in the template's {{ }} interpolation, so this value must never be interpolated with {{{ }}}. Empty, the default, suppresses the bar even when BlitzyAnnounceEnable is true, so an empty band can never reach a rendered page.

BlitzyAnnounceLabel.description: @var string Label of the announcement bar call-to-action button, anchored to the BLITZY_ANNOUNCE_LABEL environment variable. Read by BlitzyViewModel, which normalises but does not escape it; the template's {{ }} interpolation is the single escaping site. The button is rendered only when this and BlitzyAnnounceLink are both non-empty and the target passes validation; otherwise the bar shows its text alone.

BlitzyAnnounceLink.description: @var string Link target of the announcement bar call-to-action button. Read by BlitzyViewModel and validated by MediaWiki\Skins\Blitzy\BlitzyUrlValidator, which allows site-relative paths and the http and https schemes only; every other value, including a javascript: URL, is rejected and the button suppressed. Empty, the default, suppresses the button because a call to action with no target is not actionable.

BlitzyPrimaryActionLabel.description: @var string Label of the primary, outline-styled call to action in the navigation card. Read by BlitzyViewModel, which normalises but does not escape it; the template's {{ }} interpolation is the single escaping site. The label never varies with login state, which is what keeps anonymous and logged-in chrome identical outside the personal menu. Empty, the default, leaves the label empty and NavCard.mustache then renders no anchor at all, so an unlabelled call to action can never reach the page without an accessible name.

BlitzyPrimaryActionLink.description: @var string Link target of the primary call to action, validated by BlitzyUrlValidator on the same allowlist as BlitzyAnnounceLink. Empty, the default, makes BlitzyViewModel derive the target from core: Special:CreateAccount for unregistered users and Special:Watchlist for registered ones.

BlitzySecondaryActionLabel.description: @var string Label of the secondary, gradient-styled call to action in the navigation card. Read by BlitzyViewModel, which normalises but does not escape it; the template's {{ }} interpolation is the single escaping site. Empty, the default, leaves the label empty and NavCard.mustache then renders no anchor at all, exactly as for BlitzyPrimaryActionLabel.

BlitzySecondaryActionLink.description: @var string Link target of the secondary call to action, validated by BlitzyUrlValidator on the same allowlist as BlitzyAnnounceLink. Empty, the default, makes BlitzyViewModel derive the target from core: Special:Random.
